lines.text: Thank you for calling Brightwave Internet, this is Sara. How can I help you today?
Hi. My internet has been down for two days and I work from home. I'm losing work over this.

I'm really sorry. Two days without internet when you work from home is a big disruption, so let's get this sorted. Before I look at the account, can you confirm your full name and the last four digits of your account number?
Ahmed Rahman, and the last four are two two nine one.
Thank you, Mr. Rahman, you're verified. So the connection dropped on Monday, and restarting the router hasn't helped, is that right?
Yes. The light on the router is red the whole time.
Thanks. I've run a line test, and it shows a fault outside your home, so this needs a technician. The earliest slot is Thursday between nine and twelve. Shall I book it?
Yes, please. Can I get some money back for the days I've lost?
I can't apply a credit myself, but I've sent a request to our billing team with the outage dates. They'll review it and email you within forty-eight hours.
Your technician visit is booked for Thursday, nine to twelve, under ticket number B W four eight two one three. You'll get a text the evening before. Is there anything else I can help you with?
You're welcome. I hope you're back online soon. Have a good day.
